scope: UTS tower F4 edge and F8 middle, K1/3/5 r0; six tasks per method
aggregation: Each position error is the mean scan error at that position. Mean and P90 pool saved position errors within the named grouping. Across K, the same Query positions reappear under different Support budgets.
comparison_boundary: F4/F8 subset only. Methods differ in information and training conditions as identified below.

methods.refi_GP: Complete frozen three-UJI five-model ReFi plus original retained-GP adaptation, fixed probability-half combination
methods.retained_gp: Same GP predictions from each complete run, no recomputation; original UJI B0 F0-F2 GP parameters; all eight other tower H floors plus S
methods.refi: Original frozen three-UJI five-model learning branch, identical predictions to complete-run learning branch
methods.wknn_S: Original simple baseline using target S only
methods.wknn_HS: Original simple baseline using full H plus target S
methods.public_tabicl: Original public checkpoint TabICL, full H plus S in context; zero project source updates; public pretraining not audited

refi.evaluation_status: exposed_development; reader selected on UJI B0
